metadata.scope: Static/unit/synthetic tests only. No network/model provider or native mutation tool was invoked.
metadata.leakage_count_scope: Confirmed findings in the implemented trusted-runtime projection path and tests; not a guarantee about unvalidated live adapters, malicious in-process Python, caller-supplied untrusted code, or future feedback projections.

views.ORACLE_VIEW: Full canonical/private backend/evaluator/mechanism truth, for evaluation/logging only; not accepted by learner serializers.
views.AGENT_VISIBLE_VIEW: Actual bound Agent visible_policy and exact deployed public function schemas. Runtime binding reads frozen Final Context and description overrides, not canonical policy.
views.LEARNER_SAFE_VIEW: Same policy/schema prior plus deployed Parent Skill and three observed Parent trajectories with Success and binary Compliance. No user simulator scenarios.

hard_rules: Any Base-hidden truth is also absent from learner prior inputs.
No canonical/source/evaluator/Oracle feedback loaders in Diagnosis or Editor.
No privileged fallback if projections/labels/context are missing.
Semantic fields may be learner-inferred and wrong; never repaired using Oracle truth.
ORACLE_DERIVED and unknown field provenance fail closed before Editor.
Opaque E/S/R/H IDs refer only to supplied experience and hypotheses, never to a hidden canonical lookup.
limitations: Runtime capture trusts the actually deployed bound Agent and genuine observed events. Typed schemas and seals do not prove that arbitrary Python callers supplied honest events. Phase12U must verify live normalization/capture provenance.

Process-local signed immutable envelopes prevent accidental DTO forging/mutation; not a sandbox for malicious Python or a semantic proof of hypothesis correctness. Persisted envelopes cannot be resumed in another process; fail closed, then recapture/revalidate from allowed sources in a future explicit path.
LEVEL0 is the only implemented declassification. LEVEL1/2 prose/localization is intentionally not accepted, because in small hypotheses such localization may encode a LEVEL3 answer.
Current Skill is assumed to be the actually deployed Parent shared with Base. Historical privileged Skills are not automatically clean; no historical Skill was migrated this phase.
No empirical learnability, improvement, semantic correctness of model hypotheses or Editor generalization was measured.

No existing v14 launcher or benchmark manifest is redirected. NEW experience-grounded experiments use src.skill_evolution.experience_grounded_runtime, which exports only v15 and has no privileged fallback.
next_phase: Phase12U runtime boundary validation; not started.
